description: Fix the 'backend doesn't work' end-to-end run experience. Diagnosis from routing: the backend code is NOT broken — in-process every endpoint returns 200 with data because services seed from in-code sample data (get_market_radar_service @lru_cache -> build_review_records), and 232 pytest tests pass. The failure the user hits is in the RUN PATH: (a) main.py has NO startup/lifespan hook that creates the DB schema or seeds, (b) scripts/demo.sh starts uvicorn + next dev but performs NO seed/db-init step, and (c) there is a real risk the live stack appears empty/broken on a fresh clone (missing backend/data dir / empty DB / startup edge cases / CORS). Make a fresh-clone -> single documented command (make demo, Req 34.1) reliably produce a populated, working dashboard, and document the fix. Reproduce and verify IN-PROCESS with TestClient (the live dev servers are blocked by the sandbox guard).
steps: REPRODUCE FIRST: run a `uv run python - <<'PY' ... PY` heredoc that imports app.main and uses fastapi.testclient.TestClient to GET the real data endpoints (/health, /market-radar/review-counts, /market-radar/properties/mus-pineview/reviews, /sentinel/board, /sentinel/metrics, /destination/heatmap, /guest-compass/stays, /guest-compass/metrics, /concierge/metrics, /market-radar/analytics/trends, /minimal/impact). Record which return data vs empty/404. This establishes exactly what (if anything) is empty on the real run path.

INVESTIGATE DB/STARTUP: read backend/app/main.py and backend/app/core/db.py. There is no FastAPI lifespan/startup hook calling Base.metadata.create_all. Determine whether any endpoint actually depends on the SQLite DB (get_session) at runtime; if some do and the schema is never created, that endpoint fails on a fresh clone. Add a FastAPI lifespan (or startup event) to create_app() in main.py that (i) ensures the backend/data directory exists (db._ensure_sqlite_dir already does this for the engine) and (ii) runs `async with engine.begin() as conn: await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)` so the schema always exists before requests, importing the ORM models so their tables are registered on Base. If NO endpoint depends on the DB, still add the schema-creation lifespan for robustness and document that endpoints are served from the seeded in-memory services.

SEEDING IN THE RUN PATH (Req 34.1 single command): ensure the demo/run path loads all demo data automatically so a fresh clone -> one command -> populated dashboard. Check backend/app/seed/ (sample_reviews.py, sentinel_seed.py) and backend/scripts/build_dataset.py. The services already self-seed in memory on first access, but make this explicit and eager: either (a) warm the process-wide services on startup in the lifespan (call get_market_radar_service(), get_sentinel_service(), guest compass + concierge services, etc. so data is present immediately and any seed error surfaces at startup rather than on first request), and/or (b) persist/seed the SQLite DB if any endpoint reads from it. Pick the approach that makes every data endpoint return populated data on a cold start, and make it idempotent (safe to run repeatedly).

FIX scripts/demo.sh: before (or as part of) starting uvicorn, run an explicit seed/db-init step so the documented single command guarantees a populated backend. Add a step like `cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed` or a small seed entrypoint (create one, e.g. backend/app/seed/__main__.py or a scripts/seed.py, that creates the DB schema and warms/persists the seed) invoked before the servers start. Keep `set -euo pipefail` behaviour correct (the seed step must not spuriously fail). Ensure NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL wiring and CORS (FRONTEND_ORIGIN -> cors_origins) remain correct so the browser can reach the API. Do NOT launch a live uvicorn/next listener during verification (blocked); verify the seed step and endpoints via TestClient instead.

VERIFY FRESH-CLONE BEHAVIOUR in-process: delete/rename any existing backend/data/pahadpulse.sqlite to simulate a cold start, then run the seed entrypoint, then build TestClient(app) and confirm every data endpoint from step 1 returns populated data (and the startup lifespan created the schema without raising). Confirm the seed step is idempotent by running it twice.

DOCUMENT THE FIX in README.md: update the 'single demo command' section to describe that `make demo` now seeds/initialises before starting the servers and yields a populated dashboard end to end, and note the exact command(s) to run the full stack (make setup; make demo) plus how to seed independently. Keep wording consistent with the existing README voice.

Keep backend quality gates green: `cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest` must still pass (232+). If you added a seed entrypoint or lifespan, add/adjust a focused test if appropriate (e.g. a test that the lifespan creates tables / the seed entrypoint runs idempotently), but do not weaken existing coverage.
acceptance_criteria: On a simulated fresh clone (no pre-existing SQLite DB), running the documented seed/init step then TestClient(app) returns HTTP 200 with NON-EMPTY data for /market-radar/review-counts, /sentinel/board, /destination/heatmap, /guest-compass/stays, /market-radar/analytics/trends and the other listed data endpoints.

create_app() installs a lifespan/startup hook that ensures backend/data exists and creates the DB schema (Base.metadata.create_all) without raising on an empty/absent DB, and warms the seeded services so data is present on a cold start.
scripts/demo.sh performs an explicit seed/db-init step before starting the servers so the Req 34.1 single command (make demo) gives a populated, working app end to end; the seed step is idempotent.
README.md documents the fix and the exact command(s) to run the full stack end to end.
`cd backend && uv run ruff check .` and `uv run pytest` still pass.
verification: In-process cold-start heredoc: remove/rename backend/data/*.sqlite, run the seed entrypoint, build TestClient(app), assert listed endpoints return 200 with non-empty data; run seed twice to confirm idempotency
cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest
Confirm scripts/demo.sh contains a seed/init step prior to launching uvicorn (static read; do NOT launch the live server)
findings:
RUN-PATH PROBLEM (confirmed): The backend logic was fine — all 11 listed data endpoints returned HTTP 200 with non-empty data in-process via TestClient before any change, because every service self-seeds from in-code sample data behind @lru_cache/singleton getters (get_market_radar_service, get_analytics_service, get_intervention_store, get_destination_lens_service, get_sentinel_service, get_guest_compass, get_concierge). The real failures on a fresh clone were: (a) create_app() had NO lifespan/startup hook, so backend/data was never created, the SQLite schema was never built, and the in-memory services only seeded lazily on first request; (b) scripts/demo.sh launched uvicorn + next dev with NO seed/db-init step. All ORM models in app/models are pydantic (no SQLAlchemy tables registered on Base today), so no endpoint reads from the DB — but schema creation was still added for robustness per the spec.

CHANGES: (1) New backend/app/seed/warm.py — ensure_schema() (imports app.models so any future ORM tables register on Base, then runs Base.metadata.create_all inside `async with engine.begin()`, safe/idempotent on empty/absent DB), warm_services() (eagerly instantiates all 7 process-wide services so seed runs now and errors surface at startup), and seed_all() (schema + warm, idempotent). (2) New backend/app/seed/__main__.py — `python -m app.seed` CLI calling asyncio.run(seed_all()). (3) backend/app/main.py — added an @asynccontextmanager lifespan that awaits seed_all() on startup and wired it via FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan). (4) scripts/demo.sh — added an explicit `cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed` step BEFORE launching uvicorn; set -euo pipefail preserved (seed is idempotent so it won't spuriously fail); NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL + CORS wiring left intact. (5) README.md — updated the single-demo-command section to document that `make demo` now seeds/initialises before starting the servers (idempotent), the lifespan-based startup seed, and how to seed independently (`cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed`). (6) New backend/tests/test_seed_startup.py — 4 focused tests (ensure_schema/warm_services/seed_all idempotency + lifespan warms all data endpoints to non-empty 200).

COLD-START VERIFICATION (in-process, no live listener): removed backend/data/pahadpulse.sqlite, ran `uv run python -m app.seed` TWICE (idempotent, both succeeded, data dir + empty pahadpulse.sqlite created), then built TestClient(app) using the context manager to trigger the lifespan — ALL 11 endpoints (/health, /market-radar/review-counts, /market-radar/properties/mus-pineview/reviews, /sentinel/board, /sentinel/metrics, /destination/heatmap, /guest-compass/stays, /guest-compass/metrics, /concierge/metrics, /market-radar/analytics/trends, /minimal/impact) returned 200 with non-empty data; startup did not raise. demo.sh passes `bash -n` syntax check. The live uvicorn/next listener was NOT launched (sandbox guard).

BACKEND GATES: `uv run ruff check .` -> All checks passed. `uv run pytest` -> 236 passed (was 232; +4 new tests, no existing coverage weakened). `uv run python -c 'import app.main'` -> import ok. backend/data/pahadpulse.sqlite remains gitignored (not committed).
